FORM 5743: Notice of Intention to Claim Interest in Foreclosure Sales Proceeds
CC 540: MOTION TO CLAIM REMAINING PROCEEDS FROM TAX FORECLOSURE SALE
*Claims of interest in foreclosure sale proceeds for the 2022 tax year must be turned into the Wexford County Treasurer between April 1st and July 1st, 2025.
The office of the County Treasurer was established by the Michigan State Constitution and the functions of this office are dictated by State Statutes, under the guidance of the Bureau of Local Government Services Audit Division and the State Treasury Department.
The Wexford County Treasurer is custodian of all County money.
With responsibility for:
Investing funds and maintaining an adequate cash flow
Settlement with Township/City Treasurers for taxes collected for the County and State
Collecting delinquent real property taxes
Maintaining debt service accounts for bonded indebtedness of the County
Certifying warranty deeds
Sale of dog licenses
In addition to these duties, the Wexford County Treasurers office handles the entire PA 123 tax reversion process, including forfeiture, tax searches, foreclosure and sale of properties.
